name: M5.CRT.prime_crt_representative
statement: ∀ δ e : ℕ, 0 < δ → ∃ r : ℕ, r < M5.CRT.primeProduct δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ δ.primeFactors, Nat.ModEq p r (M5.CRT.repairResidue e p)
guidance: Use Nat.chineseRemainderOfFinset with t=δ.primeFactors, modulus identity, residues M5.CRT.repairResidue e. Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors supplies nonzero moduli; Nat.coprime_primes supplies pairwise coprimality for distinct indices. The subtype property gives congruences and Nat.chineseRemainderOfFinset_lt_prod gives strict product bound. Empty set δ=1 is allowed. Unfold primeProduct and use open scoped BigOperators if needed. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
